quizName: Hardest Questions in Georgia Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: When riding in a group, riders should:

options.text: All keep safe distances from each other.
Follow each other as closely as possible.
Not worry about distances between members.

questions.correctAnswerText: All keep safe distances from each other.
questions.explanation: Ride in a staggered formation. This lets you stay close together as a group while keeping safe distances between riders.

questions.question: When choosing a helmet, you should make sure it:
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets DOT standards. It should fit snugly and be free of cracks, loose padding, and frayed straps.

questions.question: To be seen more easily by other drivers, you should:
questions.explanation: Bright clothing makes you easier to see at any time of day.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Vehicles will be entering the roadway.
Come to a complete stop. Yield to traffic and pedestrians. Then proceed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop. Yield to traffic and pedestrians. Then proceed when safe.
questions.explanation: Red octagonal signs are stop signs. You must come to a complete stop, check for other traffic and pedestrians, and then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: When nearing a blind intersection, you should:

options.text: Assume other drivers will properly yield.
Move to a lane position that makes you more visible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to a lane position that makes you more visible.
questions.explanation: At a blind intersection, change your lane position to make yourself as visible as possible to other drivers.

questions.question: Before every ride, you should:

options.text: Check that your brake lights work.
Check that the paint is not peeling.
Make sure your bike is completely clean.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check that your brake lights work.
questions.explanation: Before every ride, test your brakes to make sure each one activates the brake lights.

questions.question: When stopping with a passenger, you should:

options.text: Ride a little faster than normal.
Start slowing down earlier than normal.
Merge into smaller traffic gaps than normal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Start slowing down earlier than normal.
questions.explanation: A passenger adds weight to your motorcycle. This extra weight means your bike will slow down, speed up, and turn more slowly. Slow down earlier, reduce speed overall, and find larger gaps in traffic.

questions.question: When buying a helmet, your top concern should be:
questions.explanation: Protection is the most important factor when choosing a helmet.

questions.question: If you borrow a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Assume all controls are in the same place as on your bike.
Take it out on the highway right away.
Practice with it in a safe area first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Practice with it in a safe area first.
questions.explanation: Every motorcycle is different. Before riding an unfamiliar motorcycle on the road, practice in a safe area to learn where all the controls are.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Only wear a jacket at night.
Only wear a jacket if it is cold.

questions.explanation: Always wear a sturdy jacket with long sleeves when riding, no matter how warm it is.

questions.question: No matter what helmet style you choose, you get the most protection when your helmet:
questions.explanation: Your helmet gives you the best protection when it meets safety standards, fits snugly all around, and has no damage.

questions.question: What is the only way to become sober after drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: The only way to become sober is to give your body time to remove the alcohol. Nothing can speed up this process.

questions.question: Why should you use your mirrors when stopping at an intersection?

options.text: To see if drivers behind you notice that you are stopping.
To look for dark clouds that show bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: To see if drivers behind you notice that you are stopping.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors to see vehicles coming up behind you. This helps you know if drivers see you and are reacting to what you are doing.

questions.question: When riding, wear boots or shoes that:
questions.explanation: Your footwear should be high and sturdy to cover and support your ankles. Heels should be short so they don't catch on anything. Shoelaces should be tucked in so they don't get caught.

questions.question: What should you do if you ride on a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: On a slippery surface, reduce your speed and avoid sudden moves. Use both brakes gently.

questions.question: Wearing what gives you the best chance of surviving a crash?
questions.explanation: A helmet that meets safety standards gives you the best head and neck protection. Wearing a good-quality, properly fitted helmet is the single most important thing you can do to survive a crash.

questions.question: A passenger should sit:
questions.explanation: Passengers must sit behind the operator and hold on firmly to the operator's waist or midsection. They can hold onto handgrips if the motorcycle has them. Passengers should never sit to the side.

questions.question: When traveling at night, judging distance is:

options.text: About the same as during the day.

questions.explanation: It is harder to judge distance at night than during the day. Shadows and light help you see distance. At night, artificial lights may distort these visual cues or remove them completely.

questions.question: Blind spots on motorcycles:

options.text: Should be checked regularly by riders.
Don't exist if the motorcycle has a rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be checked regularly by riders.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have blind spots like all vehicles. Always turn your head to check for traffic in your blind spot before changing lanes. Make head checks a regular habit.

questions.question: What material provides the best protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather and sturdy synthetic materials offer the best protection for motorcycle riders.
